patch.solution_addendum: Because the original fractions are defined, a and b are not 3. Together with ab=9, the condition 6-a-b=0 would imply a+b=6 and hence (a-3)(b-3)=ab-3(a+b)+9=0, forcing a=b=3, a contradiction. Therefore 6-a-b is nonzero and the cancellation is valid; the value is 1/6.

The cancellation of aq requires an explicit nonzero-term or nonzero-ratio convention. Under the recurrence definition, q=0 with a nonzero gives a nonconstant sequence a,0,0,... and an additional unlisted branch, so the source solution must either state the intended nonzero-term convention or repair the stem/options before certification.
